title: ReciprocityRow
description: Per-counterparty row in a reciprocity view's inflow/outflow ledger. Source of truth: rea_commitments + economic_events (Operational, Category C — derived projection). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

counterpartyHouseholdId.description: Household identifier on the other side of the reciprocity ledger.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the counterparty household.

committedBytes.description: Bytes committed via REA Commitment entries.

deliveredBytes.description: Bytes actually delivered (covered by economic_event observations).

honoredPercent.description: deliveredBytes / committedBytes as a fraction (0.0-1.0+; can exceed 1 when over-delivered).

online.description: Whether the counterparty has an online peer right now.
